messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 500/502 on /v1/embed in ap-south-1. Severity: P1. Triggered at 2026-04-02T01:26:39Z. Pager: lena (oncall).

lena (oncall): I'm seeing a sharp spike in 5xx from inference-node-23 and -24. Latency also up. Starting collection of kernel and runtime logs. :mag:

omar (eng-sre): joining. initial heap patterns point to model cache thrash after a recent runtime patch. putting a temporary throttle on long sessions to reduce pressure.

sara (eng-ops): executing emergency scale on pool ap-gpu-3: +4 gpus. deploy-bot, please apply.

deploy-bot: Action: scale ap-gpu-3 replica_count +4 by sara. Change id: cs-20260402-11

lena (oncall): after scale error rate dropped from ~28% -> ~3.2%. still seeing intermittent 502s for specific tenants. Can we route traffic for affected customers to ap-fallback-1?

omar (eng-sre): yes. creating routing rule: if status >= 500 and tenant in impacted_list -> route to ap-fallback-1. rule id: route-ap-3327.

incident-bot: Paging: @tia (support) @maria (cs) @henry (finance) — please identify impacted accounts for SLA review.

tia (support): pulling top impacted tenants for the window. Three standouts: GreenLeaf (enterprise), DeltaMed (enterprise), QuantifyAI (growth). Failed calls in window: GreenLeaf 210, DeltaMed 63, QuantifyAI 27.

maria (cs): I'll start outreach for GreenLeaf and DeltaMed. GreenLeaf is sensitive; loop in AMs.

lena (oncall): mitigation stable, monitoring for 45m. omar, what's root cause hypothesis?

omar (eng-sre): hypothesis: the new memory pooling change in runtime v2.14 misreports free segments for quantized KV caches, triggering aggressive eviction and then OOM on some models. Repro on a bespoke stress test. Plan: revert pooling change and harden alloc checks. Owner: omar. ETA revert + canary: 2026-04-04.

henry (finance): for SLA credits we'll need: incident id, per-customer impacted window, account IDs, and token counts for failed requests. We compute pro-rata credits based on committed spend. If on-demand, we do a goodwill token-based credit.

tia (support): impact windows (from logs): GreenLeaf 01:24:10Z - 01:41:00Z (~16m50s), DeltaMed 01:26:00Z - 01:33:30Z, QuantifyAI 01:27:20Z - 01:31:10Z.

sara (eng-ops): pulling token counts. Query run:
```
SELECT tenant, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens FROM request_logs
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-02T01:23:00Z' AND '2026-04-02T01:42:00Z' AND status IN ('500','502')
GROUP BY tenant;
```

sara (eng-ops): results: GreenLeaf: 57,200 tokens, DeltaMed: 14,800, QuantifyAI: 6,100. Pasting to thread.

henry (finance): provisional credits calc (using SLA table and committed spend):
- GreenLeaf (committed $420k/mo): affected ~16.83 min -> credit ~0.037% -> est $155
- DeltaMed (committed $95k/mo): affected ~7.5 min -> credit ~0.016% -> est $15
- QuantifyAI (on-demand): goodwill token credit estimated $75 based on token usage.
Notes: provisional until legal/accounting sign-off. I'll open billing tickets.

henry (finance): billing tickets opened: BILL-4720 (GreenLeaf), BILL-4721 (DeltaMed), BILL-4722 (QuantifyAI). ETA to apply credits: 5-9 business days pending verification.

omar (eng-sre): immediate action items:
- revert runtime pooling change + canary deploy (omar) - due 2026-04-04
- add alloc sanity checks in runtime (omar/sara) - due 2026-04-11
- add regression stress test for long-session KV behavior (olga/qa) - due 2026-04-15

lena (oncall): runbook updates needed: document emergency routing rule creation and removal (sara) - due EOD 2026-04-03. Also capture the ad-hoc throttle we used so ops can avoid it unless needed.

nina (product): let's schedule a postmortem. Proposed slots: 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC or 2026-04-04 10:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: for preferred.

tia (support): :white_check_mark: 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC (we need time to prep customer comms)

henry (finance): prefer 04-04 10:00 UTC due to month-end reporting but can review notes asynchronously.

emma (oncall-night): I'll take monitoring for the next 2h. acked.

lena (oncall): handing off to emma. emma pls post a 03:10Z status update.

emma (oncall-night): ack. will watch metrics and escalate if any 500s > 1% during watch window.

maria (cs): customer comms drafts are ready for GreenLeaf/DeltaMed; tia pls add finance wording once henry confirms.

henry (finance): once postmortem link is available I'll finalize exact credit language and attach to billing tickets. Also request accounting to queue the adjustments.

omar (eng-sre): postmortem owner: omar. Draft due 2026-04-05, publish target 2026-04-07. I'll include technical root cause, timeline, and remediation plan. Add CS and finance sections please.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-20260402-3327. Total mitigated window: ~18m.

tia (support): outreach scheduled: GreenLeaf requested an account sync; AM handling. DeltaMed update email sent with apology + note on credits (provisional).

henry (finance): updating BILL-4720..4722 with incident link and provisional amounts. tagging accounting.

sara (eng-ops): ops note: routing rule route-ap-3327 left active for 6h; removed at 2026-04-02T08:00Z after no regressions. documenting removal in runbook.

omar (eng-sre): adding one more QA note 55 we saw a handful of non-fatal degraded completions where response truncated but status 200. Adding to postmortem to track output quality regression.

lena (oncall): final note before handoff: capture any customers who saw partial text (not 5xx) so CS can include in outreach. tagging qa and cs.

emma (oncall-night): 03:10Z status: metrics stable, error rate <0.2%. continuing 2h watch.

henry (finance): once credits are applied I'll post final amounts and close billing tickets. Closing thread after postmortem publish.

nina (product): thanks team. please update the postmortem doc with missed items before the scheduled review.
